content:
Hi everyone, this is my first contribution to Mathlib.
PR #43650 defines Nat.Carmichael to address the explicit TODO in Mathlib.NumberTheory.FermatPsp.
All CI checks have passed (labeled t-number-theory). Could someone take a quick look when convenient? Thanks!
Make sure to put LLM-generated label and declare the LLM use if there is substantial LLM-generated content. You PR description looks like LLM-generated.

And, another piece of advice: rewrite the PR description by hand (i.e. without AI use), to follow [mathlib's commit message conventions](https://leanprover-community.github.io/contribute/commit.html. (If you're not unsure how, look at recently merged PRs for inspiration.) At least half of the current description is superfluous.
Mathlib already contains a definition of Carmichael numbers, see Nat.IsCarmichael. The to-do you refer to has been updated in #43651.

Thanks everyone for the feedback! I appreciate you pointing out that Nat.IsCarmichael already exists and the TODO has been updated. I will revise the PR description manually following the commit conventions and handle the LLM declaration properly.
